<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="guardrails-defense-in-depth" name="Guardrails Defense in Depth"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1180" pageHeight="650" math="0" shadow="0" adaptiveColors="auto"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=24;fontColor=#18343B;fontStyle=1;" value="Guardrails: layered boundaries, not a safety guarantee
Conceptual defense in depth; policy, tool identity and native moderation are separate console variants." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="1100" x="40" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="input" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E2F1EE;strokeColor=#76A99E;fontSize=16;" value="Request" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="140" x="40" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="inputSafeguards" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E9EDF7;strokeColor=#9AA8C2;fontSize=16;" value="Input policy
validate / admit / block" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="180" x="240" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="agent" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#18343B;fontColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#18343B;fontSize=16;" value="Agent
proposes work" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="160" x="500" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="outputSafeguards" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FCE8E7;strokeColor=#D58C86;fontSize=16;" value="Output checks
release / block / review" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="180" x="740" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="user" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E2F1EE;strokeColor=#76A99E;fontSize=16;" value="Response" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="140" x="1000" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="toolBoundary" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF0E8;strokeColor=#D99B76;fontSize=15;" value="Tool boundary
allowlist + validate arguments
enforce authorization in code" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="240" x="500" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="human" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FCE8E7;strokeColor=#D58C86;fontSize=16;" value="Blocked / needs review
no release or action
until authorized" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="180" x="240" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tool" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#E9EDF7;strokeColor=#9AA8C2;fontSize=16;" value="Permitted tool
execute + observe" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="180" x="860" y="370" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="observability" parent="1" style="text;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontColor=#18343B;fontSize=15;" value="Privacy-aware tracing and testing span all boundaries. Prompts do not grant authority.
Output filtering and review workflows require their own implementation; uncertainty is not acceptance." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="820" x="180" y="550" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="input" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;" target="inputSafeguards"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="inputSafeguards" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="agent" value="Admitted"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="agent" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="outputSafeguards" value="Final answer"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="outputSafeguards" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="user" value="Pass"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="inputSafeguards" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="human" value="Blocked / uncertain"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="agent" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="toolBoundary" value="Optional tool call"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e7" edge="1" parent="1" source="toolBoundary" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="tool" value="Authorized"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e8" edge="1" parent="1" source="toolBoundary" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="human" value="Denied"> <mxGeometry style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" target="agent" value="Result to agent via host"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1160" y="415" /> <mxPoint x="1160" y="120" /> <mxPoint x="580" y="120" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e10" target="human" value="Flagged: stop / review"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="830" y="510" /> <mxPoint x="330" y="510" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
